programme.title: 阿金
programme.desc: Ah Kam is from Mainland China and is trained in kung fu. She becomes a double in Hong Kong. Tung and his partners of the Tung's Family, a stunt man group, cannot work as stuntmen after an ambush. Tung lets Kam try being the stunt director and Kam becomes very popular. Kam married Sam and moves to Shenzhen to look after Sam's karaoke business. However, being a karaoke manager does not suit Kam. At the same time, Sam is unfaithful and so Kam returns to the movie industry and once again becomes a stuntwoman..

programme.title: 英雄本色
programme.desc: Tse-Ho works for the Triad, the deal in Taiwan turns out to be a trap by the Taiwanese gang. A shootout ensues in which Ho and Shing flee, pursued by local law enforcement. Ho's father is killed, he pleads with Kit to forgive his brother. Ho is released from prison three years later. Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. Ho spots Mark during one of his shifts; in contrast to Mark's letters, he realizes that Mark has been reduced to an errand boy for Shing (who is the new leader of the Triad). During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. Consequently, Shing begins harassing Ho in order to get him to return, including luring Kit into a trap and injuring Kit, attacking Ho's co-workers, and hav.

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: 新仙鶴神針
programme.desc: While the world of martial arts is in probably the most peaceful period for a long while, the Tien Lung Tribe suddenly emerges with a strong military presence as if it were to conquer the warring society. As its presence begin to stir up everyone in the scene, the Court decides to order the leader of the Six Fan Gates – Cho Hung to gather the ten most esteemed tribes for a conference in an attempt to prevent any chaos or unnecessary warfare in the community..

programme.title: 逆天者
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Feng was an orphan. When he went on a date with a writer Zhi, Zhi died unexpectedly. After Feng was out of prison, his father's old friend Wei took him home to stay temporarily. One day, Feng received mysterious phone message from a woman Qi, and then he began to be deeply in love with her. Under the guidance of Wei, a love expert, Feng finally won Qi's heart. Wei suddenly arrived while Feng and Qi were having their breakfast in bed..

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 影人映語 -鐵骨闖江湖 - 錢小豪
programme.desc: Being a well-known martial art movie star, Chin Siu Ho talks about his stories and personal feelings from such long journey. When got into acting since childhood, Siu Ho reveals that the encounter with Chang Cheh and Sammo Hung were the benefactors of his acting life and how he went through the mill to make action movies in the ‘80s. In particular, he has recalled his injury and hardship at the set of Hong Kong classic action-comedy ‘Mr. Vampire' that one of the scenes simply had him retaken for eight times! To know about the behind-the-scene of Hong Kong ‘80s action movies, let Siu Ho tell you more in this episode.

programme.title: 發達先生
programme.desc: Toy designer Yau is always bullied by boss and ex-girlfriend. One day, Yau runs into a beautiful but rebellious girl named Ching, who tells him she is the target of triad harassment. Yau is determined to help her, and he resigns from his job at the encouragement of Ching. The two take low-pay jobs at a fast-food chain, and gradually fall in love with each other, but their relationship is threatened when Ching's true identity as the daughter of a tycoon is exposed..

programme.title: 最佳福星
programme.desc: The lucky stars reunite again. Having the new members joined in, they are playful and frolicsome as usual. This time, their mission is to investigate a case of international ammunition trade that involves two gangs. One is the Japanese underworld society that holds many stolen diamonds, and another one is the mysterious terrorists who own an enormous amount of ammunition. Let's see how the lucky stars overcome the danger and problem.

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲：葉童．傲骨芳華: 愛情謎語
programme.desc: Abel graduated from a renowned school of fashion design in Japan. He came back to Hong Kong and joined a top fashion company. In an office party, he met Jeanne and Rookie, radio DJ who is a friend of his boss, Derek. Abel and Jeanne had a bit of misunderstanding at first and became enemies. Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends..

programme.title: 原振俠與衛斯理
programme.desc: Yuan Chen-ha saves Betsy from being sacrificed by the wicked priest in Thailand, but is stricken with seven blood curses. Soon, Yuan's veins start to burst, Wesley sends Yuan, Rainbow and Betsy's boy-friend back to find Buddha's Eye, which can cure Yuan. The wicked priest has directed the blood demon to attack Yuan and his friends. Wesley comes up with the weapons to destroy their wicked enemies..

programme.title: 衛斯理之老貓
programme.desc: One night, disturbing noise comes from an upstairs flat. Lee Don decides to go up and caution the noise-makers. He sees there are an old man, a young girl and a black cat. But Lee Don discovers that the flat is completely deserted on the next day. A cat's innards, however, are left behind. Lee Don tells this to Wisely, famous for his adventures. Wisely gets suspicious. Finally, the old man and the girl explain to Wisely that they are travelers from outer space marooned on the earth. They are making the machine to go back. An outer space killer takes possession of a police officer's body and tries to wipe them, including Wisely..

programme.title: 英雄本色
programme.desc: Tse-Ho works for the Triad, the deal in Taiwan turns out to be a trap by the Taiwanese gang. A shootout ensues in which Ho and Shing flee, pursued by local law enforcement. Ho's father is killed, he pleads with Kit to forgive his brother. Ho is released from prison three years later. Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. Ho spots Mark during one of his shifts; in contrast to Mark's letters, he realizes that Mark has been reduced to an errand boy for Shing (who is the new leader of the Triad). During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. Consequently, Shing begins harassing Ho in order to get him to return, including luring Kit into a trap and injuring Kit, attacking Ho's co-workers, and hav.

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 兩個只能活一個
programme.desc: Mo is a low-life gangster, who dreams of a better life. He sees his chance when he's promised a $88,000 fee to commit a murder. However, the day before the assassination is meant to take place, Mo bets all his money at a casino, and wins a fortune..

programme.title: 最佳福星
programme.desc: The lucky stars reunite again. Having the new members joined in, they are playful and frolicsome as usual. This time, their mission is to investigate a case of international ammunition trade that involves two gangs. One is the Japanese underworld society that holds many stolen diamonds, and another one is the mysterious terrorists who own an enormous amount of ammunition. Let's see how the lucky stars overcome the danger and problem.

programme.title: 逃學威龍三之龍過雞年
programme.desc: The Millionaire, Million Wong, is found dead in a hotelroom. The police head officer, Mr. Ta Wang Lai, orders Chau Sing Sing to be an undercover again for further investigation.

programme.title: 原振俠與衛斯理
programme.desc: Yuan Chen-ha saves Betsy from being sacrificed by the wicked priest in Thailand, but is stricken with seven blood curses. Soon, Yuan's veins start to burst, Wesley sends Yuan, Rainbow and Betsy's boy-friend back to find Buddha's Eye, which can cure Yuan. The wicked priest has directed the blood demon to attack Yuan and his friends. Wesley comes up with the weapons to destroy their wicked enemies..

programme.title: 福星高照
programme.desc: Two Hong-Kong cops are sent to Tokyo to catch an ex-cop who stole a large amount of money in diamonds. After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars,' to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it..

programme.title: 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely..

programme.title: 我家有一隻河東獅
programme.desc: During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses..

programme.title: 人嚇鬼
programme.desc: In a touring opera group, the domineering star is hated by all. The lesser actors try to give him a bad time by posing as ghosts. Their antics attract the attention of a real ghost who comes to make fun of them. Stage old hand Seng soon discovers the mischievous ghost met a violent death. Seng promises to find his remains and bury him. Unwittingly, Seng buries the wrong bones which belong to the Vicious Ghost. The Vicious Ghost comes and leaves a trail of violence..

programme.title: 鬼馬校園
programme.desc: A new school term begins. Vivacious high school girl Jane hurries back to Hong Kong from overseas, where she spent her vacation. Chinese-American college student Wan Ho follows her all the way to Hong Kong to get close to her. But Jane is so popular in school and is used to having boys around her. One of them is Tse Tin, the son of the school director. While Tse Tin and Wan Ho regard each other as rivals and fight over Jane all the time, Jane has developed a crush on the P.E. teacher! Meanwhile, Pak Yat Moon has a crush on Wan Ho, and Ka Ming has crush on Pak Yat Moon! It is a total mess and the relationships become utterly chaotic! Everything culminates in a showdown during a big basketball game..

programme.title: 油尖少爺
programme.desc: Zhan's family was very rich, but his wife died early. He and his daughter Baby depended on each other. Zhan liked dancing in nightclub which his daughter opposed. Therefore, she dressed up to work in the nightclub in order to make her dad mad. A gangster had an interest in Baby, but fortunately Cong came forward to help. Baby and Cong developed feelings for each other. Baby used her wealth to help Cong with his career, but when Cong found out that his career was helped by Baby secretly, it was difficult for him to accept. How should Cong decide.

programme.title: 「戲」遊1995: 賊王
programme.desc: Wisdom thief Yam Ka Wa having girlfriend Ann as an inside accomplice, using high-tech techniques robbed the escort vehicle and stole one hundred and seventy million dollars. Crime Unit Chief Inspector Lee and his detectives working around the clock to detect, eventually discovered clues. They suspect that Wa and Ann were the mastermind of the case, but there was no evidence against them. Lee tried various methods of interrogation to no avail, finally has to resort to torture, but the two remain resolute, enduring the torture and recriminate Lee for police brutality..

programme.title: 奇謀妙計五福星
programme.desc: The five met in prison, Teapot, Exhaust Pipe, Vaseline, Curly Jack and Larry became friends and they would stay clean from now on. In fact they formed a cleaning company and worked hard at it after their release. Little did they realize they were released together with Boss Chan of the feared underworld who immediately reactivated his money counterfeit operation..

programme.title: 南海十三郎
programme.desc: The movie bases itself on the life of 'Naam Hoi Sap Saam Long' who was a gifted, famed and productive playwright in the 1930s.

programme.title: 奇謀妙計五福星
programme.desc: The five met in prison, Teapot, Exhaust Pipe, Vaseline, Curly Jack and Larry became friends and they would stay clean from now on. In fact they formed a cleaning company and worked hard at it after their release. Little did they realize they were released together with Boss Chan of the feared underworld who immediately reactivated his money counterfeit operation..

programme.title: 新上海灘
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials..

programme.title: 百年好合
programme.desc: Millionaire Tiger Hung is told to find cure at the mysterious all-women martial arts sect Omei, and there he meets Omei's young master May. The healing process moves smoothly until May's big sister Misery shows up and challenges May into a duel. Misery has lost her mind and she threatens to destroy Omei unless May beats her with the sect's long-lost 'Heartbreak Sword Technique'..

programme.title: 賣身契
programme.desc: The contract is a piece of almost blank paper by which MTV binds all its employees to eight years of impecunious service. Chi-Man, an aspiring but frustrated artist, hates the contract since he is given no chance of getting ahead. He constantly thinks of moving to greener pastures. His brother Chi-Ying is a self-made investor who has just come up with a laugh bomb. By chance, Chi-Man becomes the host of a Cat TV program. With the aid of the laugh bomb, he becomes an instant success, yet..

programme.title: 快餐車
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking Chinese fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

programme.title: 黑俠II
programme.desc: Black Mask is back as he tries to find a cure for the genetic mutation that gives him superhuman powers. However, he finds trouble with a demented scientist, Moloch, who uses a group of pro wrestlers in his experiment to combine animal DNA with human DNA. Things get worse when Black Mask's arch nemesis, Lang, has plans of his own involving Moloch and his mutants..

programme.title: 皇家女將
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: 「戲」遊1995: 西遊記之月光寶盒
programme.desc: At the foothills of Fingers Mountain, there is one Highwaymen's Haven, operating as a motel. The gang leader is a fellow named The Joker, and the gang makes a living out of robbing the traveling businessmen and scholars. The Joker is in fact Monkey King reincarnated. Grandpa Buddha is the only God who knows about this. Two of the devils, Spider Woman and Boney M, took the guise of Sharon Stone and Madonna and wooed him into betraying this secret. The two devils decided to get the Joker out of the way so that they could capture the Longevity Monk when the time came for his reincarnation..

programme.title: 君子好逑
programme.desc: A group of intellectuals, who all actively involved in a psychological research, assume a subject Fai, who is innocent and aimless in his life, to test if love can make him into a different person. Jo Jo is the chosen girl to carry out the mission, who attracts Fai with her elegance and beauty. At the same time, she finds herself attracted by him. She wants Professor Cheung, her boyfriend, to stop such a cruel test, but she fails. The final commitment comes when Jo Jo marries to Cheung. Fai interrupts the wedding ceremony in the church by announcing his love to Jo Jo..

programme.title: 生死線
programme.desc: The story takes place on a deserted island. The only residence on the island is a family in which the mother ruled over three of her sons: Tai Fat, gloomy and sullen; Yee Fat, vulgar and cruel; Sam Fat, slightly retarded. Mother's earnest wish is to find a wife for Sam Fat to continue the family tree. Teacher Cheung, along with six of his students arrive on the island for camping. They first meet Yee Fat who brings them to the grocery for a rest. Yee Fat is delighted with the presence of the 3 young girls while Sam Fat falls in love at first sight with the charming girl Phyllis. He expresses his feelings to Tai Fat who has sworn to his mother that he will fulfill her wish to find his youngest brother a wife. He proposes to Cheung that Phyllis be married to Sam Fat. Cheung first thinks that it's a joke, but soon senses that Tai Fat is serious and that all three brothers are actually psychologically imbalanced..

programme.title: 皇家女將

programme.title: 黑雪
programme.desc: Maggie returns to Hong Kong to bring her grandmother back for settlement in Canada. Only her fiance Michael comes to welcome her back, but Jacky and Carol, her good friends and married couple, fail to appear. Jacky Chan, a cartoonist, is in fact a long-time cocaine doper and is therefore deeply in debts. Sam, one of the hired thugs of the drug-dealer constantly comes to collect debts. It greatly irritates Carol. Michael goes so far as to collaborate with the drug dealer for benefits. Moreover, he supplies cocaine to Jacky once in a while. Jacky is under the delusion that cocaine inhalation will help him gain inspiration in cartoon-drawing, but contrarily, cocaine only makes him get into real trouble. He resorts to satisfy his urge for drugs by snatching his wife's money and accidentally hurts her. Carol ultimately tells the whole story in tears to Maggie..

programme.title: 阮玲玉
programme.desc: Yuan Ling-yu, men looked at her with dreamy eyes and women looked at her sideways and full of hate. And her endings were tragic : mental breakdown, forced marriages and suicide..

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: Foon, a Public Relations manager, starts a happy life with his wife Ann after remarrying her. Kwan, a new public relation officer in Foon's department, falls in love with Foon after he shields her from being criticized, when there is friction between Foon and Ann. Thus Foon falls in love with Kwan gradually. After a business trip to Tokyo, their relationship becomes much closer, while Ann meets Chu, a councilor, who falls in love with her but can't get Ann's response. When returning to Hong Kong, Kwan doesn't want to destroy Foon's family and decides to marry her fianc? When Foon is depressed by this, Ann finds out the truth. Another rupture breaks out again.

programme.title: Yes一族
programme.desc: Five young men threw themselves with heart and soul into the work force. They have different approaches and different life styles. Ah Kit is the hardworking investment broker. He is so busy making money. Ah Chi is a postman believing in fung shui. Ah Hark is an apprentice in his family jewelry shop and Ah Wai failed in public exam. Ah Ming is the most unconventional of the five. Working in a Japanese restaurant. The five start a laundry shop which soon folds. Next, they try something new to save their business. Ah Ming leads a carefree life which dismays his girl, Yoko. Ah Hark's girlfriend Cat will move to Australia and leave him soon. Ah Ming and Ah Hark are going to lose their girlfriends. The five new generation are going their own ways..

programme.title: 少林門
programme.desc: The Shaolin Temple is the center of Chinese martial arts and the cradle of anti-Manchu patriots in the 17th century. However, a Shaolin renegade Shih has defected to the Manchu and is leading a suppression of patriots trying to overthrow the Qing Dynasty. Tan Hsiung, a patriot, is arrested and killed by Shih. The Shaolin Abbot thus calls on his best student, Yun Fei to stop Shih from killing more people. Yun happens to find help from another anti-Manchu patriot, Tan, who is actually Tan Hsiung's younger brother. Along with help of Zorro, a master swordsman..

programme.title: 飛躍羚羊
programme.desc: Alias “Springing Gazelle”, the renowned athlete Miss Chi Cheng is in Hong Kong helping to organize a training programme and hunt for a coach. Olivia was a former brilliant sprinter who has to give up running after her injury in a competition. At the beginning of the training, the girls are too pompous that they despise Olivia, until they find that Olivia is beyond their challenge, they adore her and are willing to go through the hardship but after a winning contest, they feel hostility towards each other and behave proudly. As a result, they lost in the competition with Singapore team. Olivia is so furious..

credits.director: 鄭則士, 司徒立光, 譚鋭銘

programme.title: 龍的心
programme.desc: It's the two brothers of Hong Kong action as you have never seen them before in a gripping drama where the lines blur between family loyalty and upholding the law. Jackie Chan plays Ted, a SWAT officer with thwarted dreams of being a sailor because he has to look after his mentally disabled brother Danny. The resentment boils over in a terse showdown between the two brothers. When Danny accidentally ends up with a robbery loot while playing a harmless game of cops and robbers with his friends, Ted has to make an agonizing decision. Does he save the hapless Danny? Or arrest him.

programme.title: 「戲」遊1995: 整蠱王
programme.desc: Happy specializes in playing tricks, but he refuses to work for rich man Shi. By coincidence, Happy meets Moon and falls for her. However, he is not aware it is just a trick..

programme.title: 縱橫四海
programme.desc: A trio of art burglars Joe, Jim & Cherie were orphans raised by Mr Chow and trained into pretty thieves. But they advanced to the big time. Stealing paintings proved to be most lucrative..

programme.desc: Chen's restaurant is being targeted by the local mafia. Tang fends off the gangsters and wins her admiration. The mafia boss sends a gunman to kill Tang, but Tang defeats him..

programme.title: 最佳拍檔
programme.desc: The Mafia is concluding a secret deal in Hong Kong when the loot to be handed over, a consignment of valuable diamonds, is stolen by someone who left a white glove. Based on this clue, the police thinks that it is the work of the infamous international thief 'White Glove'. Interpol is contacted and an ace detective, Baldy, is sent from New York to investigate. He is assisted by a local woman inspector known for her toughness. They start on a wrong footing initially but grow to be very fond of one another..

programme.title: 精武門
programme.desc: Chen Zhen returns to Jingwu School to marry his fiancee. But tragic news awaits him: his master Huo Yuanjia has died, apparently from illness. He's deeply saddened and traumatised..

programme.title: 上天救命
programme.desc: Mak born unlucky, he is driven to despair after a series of depressing events and got himself into a car accident. As he passed out, his spirit went to hell where the devils told him that he will die after the deaths of the Millionaire Wong, Ms. Pao and Mr. Shek. Soon Mak came to his senses. At the same time, a big bag is thrown at him from a passing car. Inside it is the dead body of Millionaire Wong. Mak went to warn Pao only to find her murdered. Mak tried to convince Shek by telling him about the deaths of Millionaire Wong and Pao but Shek didn't believe him. In total desperation, Mak turned to Shek's sister for help. At midnight, Shek had a meeting..

programme.title: 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: The Sunflower Manuscript that contains martial arts secrets is stolen from the Forbidden City. Head eunuch, Koo Kam-fook, suspects Lam Chun-nam of the theft, so he sends officer Chuen and his men to the Lam dyeing factory to investigate and kill Lam and his son, Ping-chi. Before Lam dies, he whispers to Ling Wu-chung and his schoolmate Ngok Ling-shan where he has hidden the manuscript, so that Chung can tell his son, who is not at the factory. Chung and Shan begin their trip to return to Mount Wah and meet Kwan, who is Chung's master and Shan's father. However, Chuen has already killed Chi and assumed his identity..

programme.title: 猛鬼差館
programme.desc: A Hong Kong police station used to be a clubhouse of the Japanese at the time of their occupation of the city during World War II. However, at the end of the war, many of the Japanese committed haka-kiri in the clubhouse. In the present time, after thief Sneaky Ming was captured and incarcerated at the station, he was lured into a world of the paranormal by the spirits of those still inhabiting the building. He was tricked into unleashing the fierce General Issei, who resurrects into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the city. As a result, police officers Kam Mark-K and Man-Chill attempt to put a stop to the terror.

programme.title: 魔畫情
programme.desc: Leung Chiu Wei and Willy were cartoonists. One day when they were on the way to office, they knocked down a lady-ghost Joey Wong. Joey's spirit was thus thrown into the human world. Joey knew nothing as it was the first time she came to a mundane environment. At this time, she met another demoness – Deanie Yip. Yip and her son were sentenced to death by village people because of adultery. Yip didn't do it but nobody believed her. Yip's only hope was to make her son revive from death. Thus when Yip met Willy, she selfishly kept herself and her son inspired by Willy's human spirit. She also intended to hurt Wei the same as well. Since Joey had fallen in love with Wei, she helped Wei to get away from Yip. Joey became weaker and weaker being hurt by Wei's flourishing human vitality. Wei and Joey in fact were lovers in their previous lives..

programme.title: 警察故事
programme.desc: Police officer Jackie is the hero in a police crackdown on drug king Chee. But Chee is set free on lack of evidence while Jackie is demoted. Chee, however, wants Jackie dead...

programme.title: 「戲」遊1995: 月黑風高
programme.desc: Michael Chow is the chief cop of Tai O, a small rural town on Hong Kong's outlying Lantau Island. When a local man turns up dead, urban hero cop Michael Wong is sent in to help out the locals... and what follows is a cultural clash that's both humorous and utterly entertaining! Wong is an SDU cop and takes to bullying the locals with tough and hard-handed ways, but his efforts only result in resentment and anger. It's Chow who gets what the odd residents of Tai O are about, and his lackadaisical attitude is just what's needed to handle the prickly locals. But it may take the skills of both men to solve this murder case! Though nominally a cop film, this unique creation is as much a comedy of cultural errors as a murder mystery.

programme.title: 影人映語 -型「德」起！ - 王敏德
programme.desc: Michael Wong rose to prominence on the big screen in the 80s with his “half Chinese, half foreign' identity and eye-catching appearance, from the early rebellious and unruly big boy to the tough and strong policeman role later. Looking back the bygone days, he barely knew Cantonese but was fortunate to meet a like-minded partner who helped him through the break-in period, and which film from his decades-long career impressed him the most? After played countless roles, how does he feel about his identity as an actor.

programme.title: 賭神 2
programme.desc: Five years have passed since the events of the first God of Gamblers film. Ko Chun is now living a peaceful retirement on his French estate with his pregnant wife Wan Yau, while his disciples Knife and Sing have become world-renowned in their own right. Chun declines repeated challenges from other top-ranked gamblers, having given up gambling in favor of the quiet life. Chun's friend and former bodyguard, Lung Wu, the 'God Of Guns', comes to pay him a visit. While the two are away from the house for a friendly shooting competition, Chau Siu-Chee, a Taiwanese gambler and the world's number one contender to Ko Chun's title, arrives and murders his wife and unborn son in order to goad Chun into a gambling match. After a shootout with Chau Siu-Chee's henchmen, Ko Chun arrives to discover his wife dying. With her last breath, she asks Chun to promise that he will not gamble or admit his real identity for one year, in the hopes that he will not lose his life in an impulsive act of.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough narrates the award-winning Wild City series that explores the wild side of Singapore. The star of the show is the Raffles' banded langur, one of the least-known primates on the planet. Found only in Singapore and Malaysia, there are only a few hundred left and around 60 have made a home in Singapore's rainforests.

Fatal Engineering revisits major nuclear disasters, from the 1986 Chernobyl meltdown to Fukushima’s tsunami-induced failure. These sobering events forced the world to rethink nuclear safety forever.

programme.title: Fatal Engineering 第1季
programme.desc: Nuclear power offers incredible energy potential—but at a terrifying cost when it fails. Fatal Engineering revisits major nuclear disasters, from the 1986 Chernobyl meltdown to Fukushima’s tsunami-induced failure. With expert testimony and rare footage, we uncover the cascading engineering and human errors that led to radiation leaks, environmental devastation, and global panic. These sobering events forced the world to rethink nuclear safety forever.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWTNewly minted copilot Jeff Tapper is excited for his first revenue DC-3, but his inexperience shows when he botches the approach and bounces the landing three times, nearly running off the runway. Meanwhile, for new rampie Prefkar Mony to realize his dream of becoming a DC-3 pilot, he needs to first pass the written IATRA test. He’s been studying for months, but on his first attempt, he fails. With the help of pilot/mechanic Chris Staples, Prefkar retakes the test and passes, but his victory celebration is short-lived when he’s blamed for leaving an expensive shipment of medicine marked “Do Not Freeze” in a courier van during a minus 30 weekend. Later, Mikey and Katie decide to find Joe a new dog and choose Muffy, a three-year-old dog from the SPCA who is ready to leave her pups. They bring her back to the hangar for a test drive. Joe brings DC-3 CUE out of retirement to test fly the plane for Buffalo’s summer sked duty and he brings along Jeff—and Muffy—to see if they’re.

programme.title: The Whale Whisperer 第1季
programme.desc: This film follows the inspiring relationship between whale whisperer Vicki Neville and the\nhumpback whales of Australia. Never-before-seen behaviours have been documented by a team of five cinematographers over the three-month whale season in Hervey Bay, all captured in glorious 4K. These stunning close encounters capture whales like you have never seen them before.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季
programme.desc: Mikey talks to a 15-year-old aviation buff in England via Skype, who has discovered that Buffalo’s DC3–WZS–flew on D-Day. This inspires Mikey to do something special for the 70th anniversary. He invites Cory to do a tandem parachute jump and finds out that Cory’s grandfather was a paratrooper at the invasion of Normandy. Meanwhile, Mikey takes mercy on Prefkar, working the ramp in Hay River, and offers him a chance for some pilot training on the morning DC-3 freighter. But when the time comes, Prefkar learns that he’s been bumped for pilot David Alexandre. It gets worse for Prefkar when he’s given another chance and this time the fog rolls in. Prefkar might not stick it out at Buffalo. Mikey’s D-Day plans get even bigger when he contacts the Princess Patricia Canadian Light Infantry, who were part of the Allied airborne forces that dropped behind German lines in 1944. He pitches his plan—a reenactment jump from WZS, an actual D-Day plane. But there’s a hitch: the plane needs to pass in.

programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. \nWhat becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.

programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Although the situation is bleak, there is hope.\nBack at an undisclosed reserve, Matt, KP and Graeme Smith meet another kind of team saving rhinos. From perimeter and ground-based technologies to revolutionary communication and data analysing systems, they are diving into what could be the future of wildlife conservation. Technology seems an obvious solution, but it can’t be the sole strategy, so the team visit a local community who have started a wildlife tourism reserve, which blends employment with the survival of species. It really is a war that is intensifying, and the guys witness the high level of security to protect rhinos against impending incursions at a private game reserve where another baby rhino is roaming freely with his mum. Unfortunately, it’s the exception rather than the rule. Most rhinos struggle to survive. If they survive at all. The clock is ticking, and if these solutions don’t work, they might all be gone by 2025.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季
programme.desc: Mikey shows a veteran Buffalo’s DC-3, WZS, Buffalo’s very own vintage plane from the Second World War. It is being fitted with a special ‘static’ line, which paratroopers will clip onto for a D- Day reenactment jump. But army inspectors tell Mikey a modern military needs a modern line with a winch system in case they need to retrieve a “hung-up jumper”. Cory and Mikey scramble to build the retrieval line before the inspector comes back to test it. But with their bumbling and fumbling, it doesn’t look like they will make the cut. Meanwhile, Chris Staples and some of Buffalo’s pilots head down to Fullerton, California, to Air Combat USA, where pilots get to experience aerial dogfights in real fighter planes. The pilots do yo-yos, spins and pull Gs to out-maneuver their opponent. First up in the dogfights are newly checked-out co-pilot Sam Storm versus longtime co-pilot David Alexandre. Sam wins the fight due to David’s inability to hold down his breakfast. Next up is cocky co-pilot Chris.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季第8集 -D-Day
programme.desc: The Buffalo boys gather in Red Deer for Mikey’s D-Day tribute jump. Joe and Sam scout out the designated military drop zone over Abraham Lake in the Rockies only to discover the canyon is too narrow for the DC-3. So Joe cancels the whole thing—it’s too dangerous. Mikey uses Joe’s own philosophy against him: at Buffalo, there’s always a backup plan. Joe flies out to scout a new location for the drop on the lake but hits bad weather. As Joe is about to scrap the trip, twenty paratroopers from the Canadian and American armies arrive for the big jump and are ready to go. They board WZS and Joe takes off to a site he hasn’t scouted, in weather that just keeps getting worse. As they near the drop point, he finally calls it—no jump tonight. They turn back, with all the troops still on board. Mikey’s only hope is a narrow window first thing the next morning—but only if Joe gives the final okay.

Sam wins the fight due to David’s inability to hold down his breakfast. Next up is cocky co-pilot Chris.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季第8集 -D-Day
programme.desc: The Buffalo boys gather in Red Deer for Mikey’s D-Day tribute jump. Joe and Sam scout out the designated military drop zone over Abraham Lake in the Rockies only to discover the canyon is too narrow for the DC-3. So Joe cancels the whole thing—it’s too dangerous. Mikey uses Joe’s own philosophy against him: at Buffalo, there’s always a backup plan. Joe flies out to scout a new location for the drop on the lake but hits bad weather. As Joe is about to scrap the trip, twenty paratroopers from the Canadian and American armies arrive for the big jump and are ready to go. They board WZS and Joe takes off to a site he hasn’t scouted, in weather that just keeps getting worse. As they near the drop point, he finally calls it—no jump tonight. They turn back, with all the troops still on board. Mikey’s only hope is a narrow window first thing the next morning—but only if Joe gives the final okay.

programme.sub-title: 第三十三集：大志找肖林幫忙錄製音樂
programme.desc: 大志新的紀錄片開始了後期製作，可在音樂方面總是找不到感覺。大志想在配樂中加入電結他元素，自然就想到了當年大學期間，他曾組建的業餘樂隊。而結他手正是肖林。大志上門找肖林，提出讓肖林幫忙錄製音樂，肖林還有點猶豫，馬玲卻很同意.

programme.title: 狂飆
programme.desc: 莽村青年打砸唐小龍的遊戲廳，高啟強暫停賭場生意。安欣在監視器畫面上發現唐小虎的車在出事當天出現在了遊戲廳附近，唐小虎謊稱車丟了，安欣又發現螢幕中出現的大貨車正是老默的車。在刑警隊會議上，陸寒報告大貨車曾出現在多個案發地點附近，大貨車司機可能是兇手.

programme.title: 無所畏懼之永不放棄
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：肖楠楠告劉建明誹謗
programme.desc: 夏舒約見張蘭姐，得知大伯小叔出高價收購她的股份，表示只要郝磊出高價她就投票給他，夏舒答應會回去再和郝磊商量湊錢。另一邊，羅英子告訴肖楠楠可以誹謗罪起訴欺凌為首者劉建明。劉建明怕了，找來姑父老韓幫忙。此時，陳碩收到消息，詺山的第一筆執行款到帳.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 極致新疆
programme.desc: 極致新疆第五集講述從吐魯番-哈密盆地追尋歷史的印記，在新疆“最低、最幹、最熱、最長日照、最強風”的特殊區域，看被歷史砂礫淹沒的人和事如何在此“顯影、重現”，感受時間流淌與文明交融.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 奀菇菇同秀珍妹發現，原來大家各自都有最喜愛嘅甲蟲，兩人因此成為「甲蟲拍檔」，感情更進一步。不過，這份默契很快就演變成一場比拚，各自爭論自己嘅甲蟲先係最出色的一隻.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 這是節目第一次介紹黃豆粉。黃豆粉是日本傳統食品，由大豆製成。北海道大豆產量高居日本第一。只需烘焙及研磨即可製成黃豆粉。今次亦會有專業廚師教我們烹調簡單黃豆粉菜餚.

programme.title: 歡迎來到麥樂村
programme.sub-title: 第十五集: 馬嘉被通知提早回國
programme.desc: 醫院急診來了一位高危險孕婦，情況非常危急。在條件極為有限的情況下，馬嘉和蘇心等人艱難展開了工作。隨後馬嘉鄭重地向武梅、常來、蘇心道歉，三人都很大度地原諒了馬嘉。馬嘉得知自己將要被召回國，質問江大喬憑什麼判斷自己不適合援外工作.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 養貓的人
programme.desc: 聚焦廈門鼓浪嶼愛貓人士與流浪貓的溫情故事。海島居民與貓共生的獨特關係，既有鄰里互助的溫暖，也呈現流浪貓管理、疾病防治等現實問題。旅遊開發與生態保護的平衡中，普通人的善舉讓鼓浪嶼的貓成為島嶼文化一部分.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第六集：秦川和胡兵不合被調職
programme.desc: 案子告破，刑偵總隊幹部趙飛來到河昌慰問大家，趙飛與秦川等人結下友誼。戴長江告訴秦川，市里和局裡要給秦川請功，他還想把跟秦川有矛盾的胡兵調走，可是戴長江因為職務變化，也離開了西山分局，不好再插手。最後，韓敬東提出讓秦川和胡兵皆調離西山分局.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第七集：葉茂生追捕竊賊遇險
programme.desc: 葉茂生深夜回家時偶遇一名偷車賊，上前阻止卻遭偷車賊開槍後逃跑。葉茂生重傷不治，犧牲在寒夜裡。犯罪嫌疑人牛玉國被緝拿，卻因沒有屍檢報告被檢察院退卷。秦川找到專家給出彈道測試報告，法院最終判處牛玉國死刑。此後，秦川也開始回到正軌，開始主持預審科的工作.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 杏鮑仔渴望變得勇敢，能夠參與奀菇菇與秀珍妹熱愛的刺激遊戲。為此，他穿上了一條具保護力的青苔褲，不但堅不可摧，更顯時尚。然而，他亦因此變得有些自負…全新的杏鮑仔登場了.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.sub-title: Silver Age: A Future with Finance
programme.desc: Hong Kong is aging rapidly, with seniors aged 65+ hitting 24% of the population in 2024 and projected to reach one-third by 2039. In this "city of longevity," early financial planning is vital. What is the key to a worry-free retirement? We will explore more in this epiosde.

programme.title: 談天．說地圖
programme.sub-title: 100 Years of Aerial Survey in Hong Kong
programme.desc: One hundred years ago, an aircraft soared over Victoria Harbour, capturing the city from a bird’s eye view. Over the past century, aerial survey has not only been crucial to mapping Hong Kong, but also been witnesses of the city's transformations. From Victoria City to wartime ruins, from the economic takeoff to today's digital age, each aerial photo tells a story. From rudimentary single-engine aircraft to jet planes, from primitive film cameras to multifunctional digital cameras, how has aerial survey evolved in Hong Kong.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
programme.desc: Many netizens say, “Having children should require a license.” Is it necessary to have one for keeping pets too? Perhaps out of impulse, or due to lack of knowledge, many owners have not taken pet keeping seriously. In fact, before raising a pet, there are many things that can be prepared. Some problems can be anticipated and are not difficult to identify. With proper planning, not only can harm to the pet be reduced, but the owner’s regrets can also be minimized. In this episode, several owners share how, through different experiences, they have learned to create a “life plan” for their pets—establishing together a secure, abundant, and meaningful journey of companionship.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第十二集：一次主動的進攻
programme.desc: 靳時川悶悶不樂回到消防隊，徐來追來詢問原因，得知是靳誤會了自己和霍岩宗的關係，向靳保證自己心裏只有他。霍岩宗目睹徐、靳二人的親密，不再克制心裏的感情向徐告白，但她拒絕了。靳時川探望爺爺，爺爺嘮叨靳早日成家，不要因父母的遭遇而對建立家庭這事有顧慮.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第十三集: 靳時川表明心跡
programme.desc: 霍岩宗被徐來拒絕後買醉，遇見了于詩詩。霍醉酒不省人事，于只好開車帶他回自己家。靳時川帶隊在交通意外現場救援，他用安全繩套住傷者，將他從車內救出，腿部卻因而受傷。救援結束，靳時川找到在現場採訪的徐來，詢問她和自己談戀愛的意願，徐來答應，兩人終成一對.

programme.sub-title: 大灣區青年管弦樂團首演音樂會
programme.desc: 香港演藝學院、星海音樂學院及澳門青年交響樂團協會連繫大灣區青年音樂家為觀眾呈獻《大灣區青年管弦樂團首演音樂會》，由香港演藝學院音樂學院蔡敏德教授執棒，奏響貝多芬的三重協奏曲、德沃夏克的第九交響曲《新世界》、譚盾的互聯網交響曲《英雄》等跨越文化與時代的名曲，為觀眾獻上精彩的音樂盛宴。音樂會片段由香港演藝學院攝製及提供.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 期間限定企劃，《港樂．講樂》再次走出錄影廠。繼上年Pop Up Show反應熱烈，今年強勢回歸，再次於商場和大家近距離見面，讓大家現場支持你們的偶像！. 好事當然要成雙，嘉賓當然要打孖來，今集請來超級青春活力的女圑 IdG Sundae以及新生唱將范卓賢(Jacky)一齊上來同大家見面。他們密密出歌，用作品報答歌迷一直以來的支持。他們今次除了演唱作品外，更會分享創作點滴及與歌迷玩遊戲，大家切勿錯過！. 主持：林泳怡. 歌曲：. -《Yes？No！好唔好？話俾我知道！》(IdG Sundae). -《淚光萬歲》(范卓賢).

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 醫學．人 2026
programme.sub-title: #6 與中風者同行 - 劉巨基教授
programme.desc: 俗語有說：「一人中風一家瘋。」. 外表文質彬彬的劉巨基醫生(Gary)可以說與「腦」有緣。他形容自己腦袋會不停地「放煙花」，冒起許多新主意。自從立志要幫助「中風」病人，他就把握每個機會，一直與中風人士同行。Gary多年來推動中風的治療和復康進行研究，近年更善用人工智能科技，以創新點子開發輔助中風病人復康的應用程式。 2018年，他又成立「香港大學中風研究組HKU STROKE」，一直帶領團隊有系統地展開中風研究及推廣預防中風的教育。作為中生代的醫生，在迎接科技與醫療的結合的世代，他認為擁抱科技之餘，亦不要過份依賴它，始終「以人為本」，珍惜人與人之間的溫度和交流。. 主持：黃秉康醫生. 嘉賓：劉巨基教授(港大醫學院臨床醫學學院內科學系臨床副教授/瑪麗醫院及東華醫院內科部腦神經榮譽顧問醫生).

programme.desc: 從內地來港任職投資分析員的程芷恩(高圓圓飾)，在香港的感情生活與事業也並不如意，唯一安慰是對面商廈窗前一名叫張申然(古天樂飾)的俊男經常向她隔空打情罵俏，有時還會互相鼓勵。芷恩有次在電車內，碰見了前男友與其懷孕妻子一起，芷恩落荒而逃，差點兒在馬路被車撞到，幸而，給一個打扮似乞丐的男生方啟宏(吳彥祖飾)救了。芷恩為了感恩，把前男友的東西全部送予啟宏來變賣.

programme.title: 大自然零距離 2
programme.sub-title: 第六集 城市 x 蝙蝠 x 竹林中
programme.desc: 城市裡面能否找到蝙蝠的蹤影？本集節目，主持王顥霖(Homan)及王韶昀(Mercury)將會跟隨譚宏鋒(Navid)走進公共屋邨與近郊的角落，揭開蝙蝠的神秘面紗，發掘蝙蝠匿藏的地點，例如躲藏在蒲葵樹葉内的短吻果蝠、香蕉嫩葉内的喜山鼠耳蝠、竹管内的扁顱蝠。並會一起探索蝙蝠的習性，以及牠們與植物關係。. #大自然零距離#蝙蝠#短吻果蝠#喜山鼠耳蝠#扁顱蝠.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 醫學．人 2026
programme.sub-title: #6 與中風者同行 - 劉巨基教授
programme.desc: 俗語有說：「一人中風一家瘋。」. 外表文質彬彬的劉巨基醫生(Gary)可以說是與「腦」有緣。他形容自己腦袋會不停地「放煙花」，冒起許多新主意。自從立志要幫助「中風」病人，他就把握每個機會，一直與中風人士同行。Gary多年來推動中風的治療和復康並進行研究，近年更善用人工智能科技，以創新點子開發輔助中風病人復康的應用程式。 2018年，他又成立「香港大學中風研究組HKU STROKE」，一直帶領團隊有系統地展開中風研究及推廣預防中風的教育。作為中生代的醫生，在迎接科技與醫療結合的世代，他認為擁抱科技之餘，亦不要過份依賴它，始終要「以人為本」，珍惜人與人之間的溫度和交流。. 主持：黃秉康醫生. 嘉賓：劉巨基教授(港大醫學院臨床醫學學院內科學系臨床副教授/瑪麗醫院及東華醫院內科部腦神經榮譽顧問醫生).

programme.title: 命懸一生
programme.desc: 隆冬薄暮，倪向東受託運送沉重木箱至浮峰山，卻驚恐發現箱內裝著昏迷的曹小軍，隨後木箱異變，驚慌中他砸死保安劉呈安並假扮其模樣逃竄；與此同時，衛海警方因筒子樓驚現人耳碎屍案展開排查，發現鄰居吳細妹證詞疑點重重，而當晚另一鄰居李清福也遇襲身亡，讓案情愈發撲朔迷離.

programme.title: 大港腳闖中超
programme.desc: 香港土生土長的亞歷斯祖（Jojo）2025年登陸中超，成為首位捧起中超聯賽冠軍獎盃的香港球員。2026年，他從上海海港轉戰成都蓉城，向着第二個聯賽錦標進發。這支目前在聯賽榜領跑的球隊陣容強勁，各個位置競爭激烈，出場機會來之不易。Jojo相信心態取決一切，球員要懂得在等待中凝聚力量，用心享受每段足球旅程.

programme.title: 談天．說地圖
programme.sub-title: 100 Years of Aerial Survey in Hong Kong
programme.desc: One hundred years ago, an aircraft soared over Victoria Harbour, capturing the city from a bird’s eye view. Over the past century, aerial survey has not only been crucial to mapping Hong Kong, but also been witnesses of the city's transformations. From Victoria City to wartime ruins, from the economic takeoff to today's digital age, each aerial photo tells a story. From rudimentary single-engine aircraft to jet planes, from primitive film cameras to multifunctional digital cameras, how has aerial survey evolved in Hong Kong.

programme.title: 香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
programme.desc: Many netizens say, “Having children should require a license.” Is it necessary to have one for keeping pets too? Perhaps out of impulse, or due to lack of knowledge, many owners have not taken pet keeping seriously. In fact, before raising a pet, there are many things that can be prepared. Some problems can be anticipated and are not difficult to identify. With proper planning, not only can harm to the pet be reduced, but the owner’s regrets can also be minimized. In this episode, several owners share how, through different experiences, they have learned to create a “life plan” for their pets—establishing together a secure, abundant, and meaningful journey of companionship.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 極致新疆
programme.desc: 極致新疆第六集講述從歷史回到當下，看現代新疆的活力，循着張騫“鑿空”西域的足跡，聚焦蓬勃發展的天山北坡經濟帶。烏魯木齊、克拉瑪依等現代城市共同構成了新疆經濟的重要引擎.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 本地農產品長期面對海外食品品牌及內地價格競爭，要突圍需強化品質應對。今年7月由漁農自然護理署推動，香港品質保證局認證的統一本地漁農產品品牌正式面世。初期涵蓋魚類及蔬菜，及後會擴展至豬及雞等，目標是擴大本地銷量及開拓內地與海外市場。 本地農戶等能否把握品牌機遇，開創新出路？本集探討「港產鮮味」的未來.

programme.title: 盛事傳城
programme.sub-title: 吉伊卡哇：藝術宇宙特展
programme.desc: 即日起至9月6日，尖沙咀K11 MUSEA和鄰近海濱正舉行Chiikawa吉伊卡哇：藝術宇宙特展，將Chiikawa的世界分成4個宇宙領域，引領觀眾探索作品的創作脈絡。. 在6樓的室內展區有最矚目的原畫宇宙,，展示超過130幅創作出Chiikawa的插畫家Nagano的珍貴原畫，包括早期草稿和線稿，讓大家直接欣賞作品的筆觸和細節。至於特展的焦點則是海濱戶外區域的全球第一座Chiikawa主題旋轉木馬。吉伊、小八和兔兔等8個主要角色，還有大電影的新角色，會騎上各自代表色的專屬木馬，在維港海傍營造日夜不同的Chiikawa夢幻世界.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第二百七十三集 - 《花神的獎勵》上集
programme.desc: 第二百七十三集-《花神的獎勵》上集. 《花神的獎勵》故事書內的美德公園，有著很多小仙子，其中茉莉仙子是一位非常善良的仙子，他到處幫助別人，讓我們一起看看他怎樣幫助自卑的喇叭花，引領迷路的螞蟻回家?. 編導:黃雅茵.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師與朋友外出時，意外發現騎乘滑板車的樂趣。在學習使用的過程中，他開始探索滑板車，如何由玩具性質，逐漸演變為代步工具。尋古大師騎乘滑板車穿梭於歷史場景之中，他不但與美國的郵差及警察同行，更與英國爭取婦權的人士並行，展開一段充滿動感與歷史意義的旅程.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 彼德和賽思有個重要的約會……但他的嘴唇乾裂了！尋古大師帶彼德從古埃及和希臘的美容院，走到20世紀美國的藥局和工廠，尋找一些潤唇膏。他向我們展示了潤唇膏在滋潤雙唇以外，亦有著創新的生產過程！如今，它已成為所有滑雪愛好者的必備用品.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 一起來發掘我們的強壯寶寶排行榜，包括將擁有地球上最強咬合力的鹹水鱷寶寶，以及能夠攜帶體重三分之一重的獵物的小鷹。在本集中，我們將深入了解這些年幼動物的獨特生理與行為特徵，探討這些特質如何令牠們躋身動物王國中的精英行列.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: Located in the Yuen Long Industrial Area, an industry-leading large laundry company collaborates with a social welfare organization to transform logistical work into opportunities for people with disabilities to showcase their strengths. This program not only addresses manpower needs and enhances service quality but also brings dignity and a sense of achievement to the employees. . Among them, the senior employee, Ho Gor, has grown from an apprentice into a trusted backbone of the factory since joining in his twenties. Department manager, Yuk Jie, patiently guides and assists disabled employees in learning and growing at work. The laundry company firmly believes that receiving the "Inclusive Buddy Award" is thanks to the support and inclusiveness of all colleagues. It is this culture that enables Ho Gor and many logistical staff to find their self-worth. . On the other hand, in Hong Kong's tech industry, software testing positions are highly repetitive and require technical knowledge, involving repeated checks of code and interfaces. A local tech company collaborates with a social enterprise to offer job opportunities to youths on the autism spectrum, discovering that their traits—high focus and perseverance—are exactly the advantages needed for this position. When these traits are transformed into professional skills, the possibilities in the workplace far exceed expectations. . Both companies prove that opening up to provide opportunities yields much more than anticipated.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第十四集: 決查意外真相
programme.desc: 徐來發現交通意外疑點重重，認為問題出在TC公司生產的車載冰箱上。霍岩宗和于詩詩的親密圖片被曝出，霍順勢和于簽訂協議，假扮情侶，對外承認了兩人的戀愛關係。徐來到醫院採訪車禍生還者趙麗，遇上臧秋阻止，後得知徐查清真相是為趙麗爭取賠償，臧欣然應允.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第十五集: 徐來被恐嚇
programme.desc: 徐來到TC公司見老闆孫磊，指出該公司生產的車載冰箱有安全問題，要求對趙麗賠償並公開道歉，召回有問題的批次。孫磊拒絕，二人不歡而散。孫囑咐秘書要想辦法讓徐封口及令趙放棄起訴。徐來的住所被破壞，外牆上寫滿恐嚇字句，靳時川擔心徐來的安全，帶她回自己家過夜.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈: 粵劇-紅拂女私奔
programme.desc: 《紅拂女私奔》又名《風塵三俠》，講述中國古代俠義傳奇《虬髯客傳》中三位主要人物：虬髯客、李藥師和紅拂女。劇情描述唐太宗愛將李靖，與紅拂女張出塵相戀，後結識豪俠虬髯客，結拜成「風塵三俠」與李世民交鋒的故事。故事背景設於隋末，各路英雄爭霸。李藥師選擇李世民為發展志向之領，虬髯客則自認為有領導天下之能，而紅拂女之出現便改變一切。他們相互惺惺相惜，結義金蘭。兄弟情、夫妻愛、君臣義之交織成深刻的歷史佳話，長烙後世心中。. 這部粵劇不但保留本土粵劇唱腔及發掘傳統曲牌，當中更為紅拂女添加與眾不同的劍舞。一手舞水袖，一手舞劍，為觀眾帶來一場跌宕起伏的歷史劇情，及難忘的視聽盛宴。. 編劇:謝曉瑩. 主演：李龍、謝曉瑩、阮兆輝、溫玉瑜、郭啟煇、陳紀婷.

programme.title: 慶祝香港回歸祖國29周年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動匯演
programme.sub-title: 慶祝香港回歸祖國29周年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動匯演
programme.desc: 由教育局推出的「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動系列，以多元化的學習活動推動國民教育。節目《2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮》一連三十二集走訪多個由教育局聯同東華三院、保良局、中華基督教會香港區會、九龍樂善堂、天主教香港教區、香港聖公會、香港津貼中學議會、香港直接資助學校議會、香港資助小學校長會和津貼小學議會籌辦的「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動，與觀眾一起了解學生如何透過一系列活動去認識中華文化，厚植家國情懷。. 一系列活動在七月進入尾聲，讓嘉賓及同學在匯演中一同回顧過去一年的活動點滴及學習成果，同時慶祝香港回歸祖國29周年的大日子.

programme.desc: 在跳傘運動事故後，富有的大亨菲臘頸部以下身體癱瘓，只能坐在輪椅，因此他僱了黑人青年迪維斯來當作看護。兩個世界相互碰撞、融合，於是一段不可思議的、奇妙的友情誕生了.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 「明明只是肚子痛，為什麼躺下來更痛？背後還像被火燒一樣？」. 「大便表面浮油且惡臭無比，真的只是普通的腸胃敏感嗎？」. 很多人以為上腹劇痛只是普通胃痛，睡一覺、吃飽飯，或者吐乾淨就沒大礙。大錯特錯！這可能是胰腺組織正被「自我消化」的急性胰腺炎，一旦掉以輕心，有機會引發全身炎症反應，隨時致命！至於慢性胰腺炎則是胰腺長期反覆發炎而逐漸纖維化、硬化，導致胰腺功能不可逆損害的一種疾病。. 今集嘉賓醫生將分享辨別胰腺炎與普通胃痛的實用秘訣，講解膽石、高血脂、酗酒等隱形發病誘因，並解構慢性胰腺炎如何一步步引發糖尿病與胰臟癌的連鎖反應。. 主持：董光達醫生、羅鈺文. 嘉賓：司徒偉基教授（香港大學臨床醫學學院內科學系臨床教授/腸胃肝臟科.

programme.title: 香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《AI教與學》. AI走進校園，不只是一場技術更新，更是一場教與學的重新思考。. 救世軍田家炳學校的校長及老師們，一邊學習新工具，一邊守護教育的初心。他們着力教導學生運算思維的同時，同時謹守不應『為用而用』的理念。. 相對於一班出生在網絡及虛擬時代的年輕人，AI對老師們帶來的挑戰或許更大。天主教培聖中學特別成立了AI教學支援組，讓老師們在迎接科技衝擊的同時，也反思他們真正可以教導學生的是什麼？. 心光學校的一眾視障學生日常要應付的不只是作業及考試，更要解決生活中許多的困難。AI如何幫助他們跨越障礙，讓他們進一步跟社會接軌？. AI素養不單是教學生用科技，更是教他們在科技洪流中，仍然懂得提問、仍然好奇、仍然有人情味.

programme.sub-title: 第十六集: 乞力馬扎羅山雪豹的意義

programme.title: 31看世界 - 守護天堂
programme.desc: 智利巴塔哥尼亞的一個關鍵地區，自從百內國家公園在一九五九年成立以來一直受到保護。接壤安第斯山脈的平原及山丘見證了多種動物回歸，例如大型掠食動物美洲獅、康多兀鷲、阿根廷狐以及牠們的獵物，例如原駝。當地的旅遊業在過去二十年增長了十倍，刺激當地經濟增長，令與野生動物共處的牧場主人喜出望外。但全球暖化及山火對這個脆弱的生態系統構成了新威脅。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年8月12日 星期二 晚上10時. . A critical region of Patagonia, Chile has been protected since the creation of Torres Del Paine National Park in 1959. The plains and hills bordering the Andes have seen the return of large predators such as pumas, condors and foxes – as well as their prey, such as guanacos. Tourism has increased tenfold in the last 20 years, boosting the local economy; much to the delight of the ranchers who live alongside all this wildlife. But global warming and wildfires pose new threats to this fragile ecosystem. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.08.12 Tue 10pm.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第九集：黃豆盜竊案再被秦川破獲
programme.desc: 秦川審訊了王五，他交代偷糧團夥的頭是李埋伏。秦川帶人來到李國英家，發現牆上的日曆上有一個電話號碼。秦川根據電話號碼找到了一個叫順天福的飯店，在一番探查下，發現一群人正在院子裡挖地道，原來是一團盜賊，盜賊的頭目就是李國英。秦川請來當地民警協助抓捕盜賊.

programme.title: 31看世界 - Gordon Ramsay 瘋味之旅 3
programme.desc: 今集， Gordon Ramsay 到了克羅地亞伊斯特里亞半島，尋索各樣媲美意大利的世界級優質食材。他在沒有用氧氣樽的情況下，自由潛水以獲取當地獨有的貝殼軟體動物，又放下偶像包袱，前往捕釣墨魚，追逐山羊以取芝士，及到牧場擠驢奶。他又學會尋找珍貴松露的秘技，並嚐了頂級橄欖油。這一切準備功夫，讓他與當地名廚David Skoko終極對戰。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年1月7日 星期二晚，10時30分 Chef Ramsay explores the untouched peninsula of Istria, Croatia for ingredients that rival the best of Italy in their world-class quality. He learns the secrets to finding exquisite truffles and making exceptional olive oil, before he tests his newly found skills against local chef David Skoko. . Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2025.1.7 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.sub-title: 第三十六集：肖建回到養老中心
programme.desc: 肖建完成了國外的康復療程，回到養老中心。雖然還沒能站起來，但身體和心理都有了很大改善，一大家子人終於再次團聚了。可肖長慶發現肖建一直不願出門，只把自己關在屋裏經歷艱苦的復健康過程。肖長慶明白，在肖建內心還遠遠沒有真正走出陰霾.

programme.title: 狂飆
programme.desc: 2021年，教育整頓第三指導小組，徐忠和紀澤被任命為組長和副組長抵達京海。兩人意識到內部出現了問題，在龔開疆死後，紀澤詢問徐忠下一步工作如何展開。高啟蘭去警局找被拘留的高曉晨、黃瑤，高啟強帶唐小虎等人也一同前來。安長林告訴安欣他把安欣推薦給了專案組.

programme.title: 31看世界 - Gordon Ramsay 瘋味之旅 3
programme.desc: 今集， Gordon Ramsay 到了克羅地亞伊斯特里亞半島，尋索各樣媲美意大利的世界級優質食材。他在沒有用氧氣樽的情況下，自由潛水以獲取當地獨有的貝殼軟體動物，又放下偶像包袱，前往捕釣墨魚，追逐山羊以取芝士，及到牧場擠驢奶。他又學會尋找珍貴松露的秘技，並嚐了頂級橄欖油。這一切準備功夫，讓他與當地名廚David Skoko終極對戰。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年1月7日 星期二晚，10時30分 Chef Ramsay explores the untouched peninsula of Istria, Croatia for ingredients that rival the best of Italy in their world-class quality. He fights for oxygen freediving for local mollusks, risks his pride fishing for rare cuttlefish and chases after goats for cheese and donkeys for milk. He learns the secrets to finding exquisite truffles and making exceptional olive oil, before he tests his newly found skills against local chef David Skoko. . Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2025.1.7 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.title: 家國萬里
programme.desc: This episode explores the evolution of written language, urban planning, and the enduring philosophy of “harmony between Heaven and Man”.

programme.title: 證義搜查線之騙局拼圖
programme.desc: Aunt Bing, around 65 years old, had a strained relationship with her son after losing her husband at an early age. Feeling empty and lonely, she fell into the arms of an online scammer, who lured her into investing her life savings in a fraudulent stock trading platform. Unfortunately, she lost everything she had invested. Hong Kong Securities and Futures commission's investigation team, led by senior manager Tony Tam, along with new team member Crystal Yu, embarked on an investigation to uncover the individuals responsible for the fraudulent platform. They traced the suspected mastermind, a Hong Kong citizen named Tang Chi-Kwun, who was residing in Malaysia. With the assistance of local authorities, Hong Kong Securities and Futures commission conducted a video interview with Tang. However, he came prepared, making numerous excuses such as feeling unwell, having a poor memory, and displaying unstable emotions to evade questioning. Despite feeling helpless in the face of his despicable actions, Crystal, with her compassionate stance, could do little to confront him. On the other hand, Tony, experienced and unfazed by such tactics, approached him from a different angle and eventually saw through Tang's scheming. With relentless pressure, Tang was forced to confess to his crimes. Although they succeeded in preventing another scam from taking place, the insidious greed led Aunt Bing to fall into an even larger stock market fraud once again.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 司馬金龍墓石雕棺床1965年出土於山西大同石家寨村，屬北魏時期藝術珍品。棺床底座呈倒山字形，有四尊大力士奮力托舉，融合犍陀羅風格與中原服飾紋理。棺床雕刻十三位伎樂童子，姿態各異。墓主司馬金龍為漢族與鮮卑族通婚後代，出身高門，官爵顯赫。此棺床生動展現北魏時期佛教東傳、絲路文化交融的歷史圖景，是中國石刻藝術承先啟後的重要作品，為後世隋唐石刻的輝煌奏響序曲.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 青花蕭何月下追韓信圖梅瓶
programme.desc: 青花蕭何月下追韓信圖梅瓶為元末明初罕見的青花瓷珍品，高44.1厘米，其胎質潔白細膩、白釉潔淨瑩潤、青料濃艷優雅，是元代青花瓷的巔峰之作。瓶身繪畫的是秦末「楚漢相爭」的故事，人物卻穿着宋代服飾，元代雜劇的演繹，令歷史與藝術在梅瓶上交融。此瓶融合草原民族的鈷藍之美、波斯陶器的白地藍彩，經由絲路傳入景德鎮，在1300度高溫中燒製而成，見證中外文明交流的輝煌歷史.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 四牛鎏金騎士銅貯貝器
programme.desc: 四牛鎏金騎士銅貯貝器出土於雲南石寨山10號墓，高50厘米，屬於戰國秦漢時期滇池流域的古滇國青銅器。器身束腰圓筒，兩側有虎攀附，器蓋上四牛逆時針奔跑，中央佇立一位鎏金騎士，佩劍策騎，象徵墓主人的權力與財富。貯貝器為貯藏海貝之容器，見證古滇國與南亞、西亞的國際貿易。此器融合「失蠟法」與「範鑄法」工藝，亦反映古滇人「以虎為尊，以牛為富」的信仰，是研究古滇青銅文化與中原交流的重要物證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: T形帛畫出土於馬王堆一號墓，長205厘米，上部闊92厘米，下部闊47.7厘米，遣冊中名為「非衣」，乃舉行葬禮時為墓主引魂升天之銘旌。帛畫以漢代宇宙觀為架構，分天上、人間、地下三層，描繪辛追夫人靈魂歷經重重關卡，由水神禺彊保護逝者靈魂免入冥界，最終抵達天國燭龍神所在。畫中可見多處改繪痕跡，反映漢初禮儀制度之演變。帛畫承襲楚地繪畫傳統，以絢麗圖像展現漢人浪漫奔放的風格，是研究先秦至漢代繪畫藝術及宇宙觀念的珍貴寶藏.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 馬王堆一號墓為西漢長沙國丞相利蒼及其夫人辛追之墓，建於漢初、約公元前163年。其「井」字形木槨採用「一槨四棺」結構，規模宏大，是迄今出土最大最完整的漢代井槨實物。四重套棺所用之顏色及繪畫的圖像，神秘而浪漫，具典型楚文化風格。木槨分層象徵天界、人間、地界，槨室佈置如墓主生前居所，東、南、西三面廂室裝滿陪葬品，體現「事死如事生」觀念。辛追夫人屍身及大量陪葬品因密封保存完好，是研究漢代文化的重要實證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 青瓷釉下彩羽人纹盤口壺
programme.desc: 青瓷釉下彩羽人紋盤口壺出土於三國東吳時期，高32.1厘米，壺身飾有佛像、雙首連體鳥等紋飾，以褐彩勾勒，上覆青黃色釉，是迄今所見最早使用釉下彩繪裝飾瓷器的典型之一。此壺將道教羽化、佛教輪迴等元素融於一體，反映古人對飛升成仙的嚮往。其精湛工藝為後世青花瓷、釉裏紅等瓷器品類奠定基礎，改寫了中國陶瓷史.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 秘色瓷蓮花碗1956年出土於蘇州虎丘雲岩寺塔，屬五代時期越窯精品，由碗身與盞托組成，碗身如蓮花瓣般伸展，盞托似碧波蕩漾，釉色蒼翠明亮、瑩潤內斂。世人驚嘆秘色瓷蓮花碗「不似人間物」，卻不曉得它本是用於佛教供奉之物。此碗初稱「青瓷蓮花碗」，後因法門寺地宮出土同色秘色瓷及《衣物賬》記載，方得以正名。其釉色「如冰似玉，無水似水」，體現越窯青瓷最高工藝水準，亦承載唐風宋韻之美學精神，是中國陶瓷史上的珍貴瑰寶.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 一號青銅神樹1986年出土於四川廣漢三星堆遺址，高3.96米，是現存同期體積最大之青銅單件文物。神樹分三層九枝，枝上有花朵、果實及神鳥，似乎隱喻生命繁衍及自然規律的共生；樹旁有龍盤踞，呈現古蜀人「通天達地」的宇宙觀。其造型與《山海經》所載「扶桑神樹」高度脗合，應為祭祀儀式的核心聖物。神樹歷經三千年重現於世，是古蜀文明信仰與藝術智慧的結晶.

programme.title: 悅讀憲法 英文版
programme.sub-title: Education Vision — Learning Mission under the Constitution
programme.desc: Education is indispensable to the nation’s development. Article 23 of the Constitution emphasises the need to train all kinds of specialised personnel to serve socialism, and give full play to the role of intellectuals in modernisation. How does the Constitution provide institutional safeguards for educational undertakings, and support Hong Kong schools in nurturing talent essential to the nation’s development? This episode features a visit to Kowloon True Light School to explore how the school nurtures students through curriculum design and diverse activities, thereby accomplishing the education mission conferred by the Constitution, and cultivating a new generation with patriotism and a strong sense of social responsibility.

programme.title: 盛事傳城
programme.desc: From now until 6th September, the “CHIIKAWA ARTIVERSE” Exhibition is being held at K11 Musea and the nearby waterfront. The world of Chiikawa is divided into 4 “Universe” domains, leading visitors to explore the work in-depth. In the indoor exhibition area on the 6th floor, the highlight is the Original Drawing Universe, which showcases more than 130 reproductions of original drawings and sketches by Nagano, the illustrator who created Chiikawa. Visitors can directly observe the vitality and charm of the characters through the lines. The focus of this exhibition is the world’s first Chiikawa-themed carousel in the outdoor area. Chiikawa, Hachiware, Usagi, other characters and new characters in the movie ride on a horse with their distinctive colours. Situated by the Victoria Harbour, CHIIKAWA-Go-Round creates a Chiikawa fantasy world that’s different day and night.

programme.title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.sub-title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇製作特輯-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.desc: 「全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮暨主題講座」，由香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會(國安委)主辦。香港電台除了負責直播之外，亦就當中的青少年短劇表演製作特輯。. 同學隨參訪團參觀內地及香港與抗戰相關的地點，深入了解到先輩在抗日戰爭中所展現的偉大抗戰精神，並將體會融入短劇演出中，呈現中國共產黨領導的東江縱隊在抗日戰爭中的英勇事跡，表達對國家安全的理解及愛國情懷。節目旨在提升市民的國家安全意識，並以深入淺出的方式讓市民明白國家安全的重要性、全面性，以及國家安全與全港每一位市民的密切關係.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 本地農產品長期面對海外食品品牌及內地價格競爭，要突圍需強化品質應對。今年7月由漁農自然護理署推動，香港品質保證局認證的統一本地漁農產品品牌正式面世。初期涵蓋魚類及蔬菜，及後會擴展至豬及雞等，目標是擴大本地銷量及開拓內地與海外市場。 本地農戶等能否把握品牌機遇，開創新出路？本集探討「港產鮮味」的未來.

programme.title: 看神州
programme.sub-title: 新疆棉花產業實現機械化減省人手 紓壓玩具流傳暗黑玩法惹關注
programme.desc: 新疆去年棉花總產量逾616萬噸，佔全國產量近9成3。本台記者隨團參與「太陽計劃」活動，訪問了在當地擁有棉田的商人，他表示，新疆的氣候條件有利棉花生長，幾乎所有棉田亦已做到自動化、機械化，有助節省人手。. 紓壓玩具透過將公仔「搓圓撳扁」，讓人減壓，但內地近日流傳這種玩具的「暴力化」玩法，社會關注對未成年人的潛在影響。. 理大航天學者解構長征十號乙運載火箭，早前完成全球首次海上「網系回收」，有何重要意義。. 今集節目亦介紹重慶推出官方的託管服務，解決在職父母暑假煩惱；以及寧夏的民宿管家如何以「十八般武藝」，為旅客帶來賓至如歸的感覺.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 -- 唐代建築篇 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: From Datong to Nara - Echoes of Ancient Sentiments
programme.desc: In addition to the Yungang Grottoes, Datong City has many other attractions, such as Shanhu Temple and Southeast Village. . Shanhu Temple is one of the first national key cultural relic protection units. Inside, there is a Liao dynasty wooden structure and three Jin dynasty wooden buildings. The two hosts, accompanied by the newly met architectural scholar Mr. Ma, take an in-depth tour of Shanhu Temple. . Southeast Village, on the other hand, is a unique cultural and artistic space transformed from an ancient architectural complex. It hosts many artists, along with a coffee shop and various local specialty boutiques, creating an intersection of historical and modern time, making it a significant contemporary cultural and artistic space. . After exploring Shanxi and seeing numerous ancient architectural sites, the hosts' interest in Chinese ancient architecture and culture has grown even stronger. They decide to take another stylish journey together and travel to Japan, first going to Nara to visit Tang dynasty architecture, specifically Todai-ji Temple. They will then seek out various local cultural experiences, such as a tea ceremony workshop and an ink-making workshop, both of which have an inseparable connection to Chinese culture.

programme.title: 中華知識王
programme.sub-title: 第四集 - 中國歷史X雲南古鎮謎題激戰｜明朝官員驚世創舉重現！西方人也為之敬仰！？｜鄱陽湖漁民智慧考驗
programme.desc: 今集有匯聚八方才子的「五湖四海隊」、亦有江湖兒女踏上問答征途的「中華英雄隊」及綠茵足球場上的兵法少年「龍城飛將隊」，到底哪一隊能夠破解國家機關圖片謎題、細數歷代軍神戰績、解析航母科技密碼，最後從嘉賓評判鄧飛校長手上奪得「中華知識王」頭銜？而鄱陽湖的漁民、著名文人在青島的故居、雲南騰沖的「和順古鎮」，又會為一眾參賽隊伍帶來哪些難題？而知識小王子亦會扮演明朝官員，坐上木櫈，演繹一件相傳當時的驚世創舉，後世更用他的名字為月球的環形山命名。. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌揚. 嘉賓評判：鄧飛. 參賽隊伍：龍城飛將隊、五湖四海隊、中華英雄隊. 香港電台與政制及內地事務局聯合製作，5月24日星期六晚上8時播出.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 薄扶林南萬人「原區安置」計劃
programme.desc: 接近六十年歷史的華富邨，設施逐漸老化；為提升居住環境，政府推動薄扶林南公營房屋發展，同步展開華富邨重建計劃。土木工程拓展署在薄扶林南的五幅進行土地平整工程，全面配合重建計劃。主持將帶觀眾了解五幅這項造地工程怎樣打破地理限制，將「原區安置」的承諾一步步化為現實，讓華富邨的居民，延續對薄扶林南區的鄰里網絡及生活習慣。. 想睇更多 : https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt31/programme/governmentandyou/ 逢星期一至日. 晚上8 時25分. 港台電視31. 立即下載「香港電台隨身版（RTHK On The Go）」緊貼最新節目：https://rthk.hk/otg 記得LIKE + 訂閱+ 推播通知！ #政正關你事 #港台電視31 #華富邨 #薄扶林南公營房屋 #華富邨重建計劃.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂 (英文版)
programme.desc: As a cornerstone that has influenced the entire European culinary landscape, Italian cuisine celebrates an unpretentious food culture that places the utmost importance on ingredient selection and cooking techniques. Chef Alessandro Angelini brings exquisite Italian dining to Hong Kong with a creative touch. The programme takes viewers deep inside the kitchen of Ale's restaurant to witness the birth of handmade pasta, showcasing the authentic flavors of Italian cuisine as it takes root in Hong Kong. . Listen to a cultural dialogue that spans from Ale’s hometown beaches of Rimini to the shores of Hong Kong. Through the hands that knead his dough and the footsteps that explore the city, experience his personal philosophy of life in Hong Kong.

programme.title: 夜．遊香港 ( 英文版)
programme.sub-title: 深宵交通導賞團(英文版)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
照顧者們
programme.desc: 本集將講述兩位媽媽，照顧特殊教育需要(SEN)兒子的故事。. 何媽媽的兒子熙仔小時候確診自閉症，丈夫一直不願接受。兒子其後更被確診患思覺失調，丈夫同樣不願承認。得不到另一半理解及支持，何媽媽只好跟兒子同行。一直以來，她夾在丈夫和兒子之間，獨自承受作為「照顧者」的壓力。. 後來，她自己也出現抑鬱的症狀。她告訴兒子的心理學家，開始接受若無法改變丈夫的想法，只好改變自己。近年，她在浸信會愛羣社會服務處的精神康復者家屬資源及服務中心找到同路人，大家一同分享當照顧者面對的困難，終於感到有人明白自己。. 何媽媽和熙仔的故事，也許對本集另一主角嘉嘉和洭洭有所啟發。就讀小四的洭洭是專注力不足/過度活躍症(ADHD)和自閉症譜系障礙患者，由母親嘉嘉獨力撫養。自年少時已經確診抑鬱症的嘉嘉，經常擔心自己無法獨力照顧洭洭，心中很多焦慮和自責，難以抒發龐大壓力。. 懂事的洭洭作為小家屬，明白母親有時會傷心難過。他有自己一套開解母親的方法，雖然未必是最好的方式，但經過社工的協助，洭洭逐漸了解媽媽的需要。反之，嘉嘉見證着洭洭的成長，也學懂欣賞自己，肯定自己作為母親的價值.

Listen to a cultural dialogue that spans from Ale’s hometown beaches of Rimini to the shores of Hong Kong. Through the hands that knead his dough and the footsteps that explore the city, experience his personal philosophy of life in Hong Kong.

談天．說地圖
programme.desc: Speaking of maps, what comes to your mind? A graph with different colors and symbols? Dense red and green lines showing real-time traffic conditions? Or perhaps a satellite image of the townscape?. Or photorealistic view where you can navigate between skyscrapers as if in real life?. 3D Digital Map covering all of Hong Kong have been released for public use in phases. When cities represented on maps transform from flat planes to three-dimensional spaces, how will it change our lives? How are 3D digital maps, rich geospatial information and datasets, produced?. From town planning to construction, from professional to everyday applications, how does 3D Digitals Map build the foundation for smart city advancements of Hong Kong.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Guardians of the Mai Po Wetland
programme.desc: The Mai Po Inner Deep Bay Wetland is classified as a "Wetland of International Importance" and is the only wetland reserve in the city. It has extremely high ecological value. Several experts were invited to guide the host on how to become a conservationist and learn how to manage the Mai Po Wetland.

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.sub-title: 譚健樂：用故事連結人心
programme.desc: 譚健樂（Luke）是社企「街坊帶路」共同創辦人及行政總監。畢業於香港科技大學工商管理課程後，他沒有選擇商界高薪之路，反而以社區為舞台，創立以社區導賞為概念的社企「街坊帶路」，培訓街坊成為導賞員，帶領市民走進香港每個小社區、講述地方故事，希望讓人與城市重新連結。. 近年，經歷親人患病與面對社企營運壓力，他更關注青年情緒健康議題，並與家人創立社企推動情緒教育。本集節目將跟隨 Luke 走進社區，見證他如何從導賞員到心靈同行者，讓更多人透過故事，彼此連結，築起一個有溫度、有共情的社會.

programme.title: 家國萬里
programme.desc: Set against the deserts of Xinjiang, this episode uncovers ancient and modern innovations in technology, culture, and governance that continue to inspire progress.

programme.title: 證義搜查線之騙局拼圖
programme.desc: The boss of a listed medical beauty company, Rosita Chiang from "Beauty In The Making," raised funds through a new stock allocation method to purchase "On Yin Pharmaceutical," which claimed to have great potential. However, Hong Kong Securities and Futures commission suspected that the latter was just a business-obscure shell company. Investigator Crystal encountered a minor accident and got injured while conducting an on-site inspection of the factory alone. However, her supervisor, Tony, reiterated his disagreement with her overly aggressive approach and revealed his own investigation: Rosita's offer to purchase the company from the person in charge of "On Yin". Mak Kong, was a pretext for stock allocation. Prior to this, Chiang had manipulated "dummy accounts" to boost the stock price and create a false positive image. However, all the accounts were located offshore, making it difficult to gather evidence. Determined, Crystal held on and continued to search through a large amount of data, finally finding a loophole and successfully proving that Rosita Chiang directly caused market misconduct, leaving her speechless despite her previous arrogance. In fact, Tony and Crystal have pre-existing values based on their life experiences. Crystal had a close friend who was deceived and suffered financial and emotional harm, leading Crystal to harbor deep resentment towards scammers. On the other hand, Tony has sailed through many ups and downs in life and has come to understand that everything has its causes and consequences, and there is no need to be overly attached. Their differences in values have become more apparent in their investigative work. How can they successfully reconcile their differences.

programme.title: 香港故事-從獅子山遠眺神州大地
programme.desc: 中國古代皇帝貴族一般會學什麼?九歲的宋哲宗遇上理學大師程顥，又受到什麼的教導呢？大理，位於中國西南的一個尊崇佛教的古國，為何他們的國王，有不少都選擇為僧呢?全盛時的大理，有大大小小的佛廟數以千計，所以大理有妙香古國之稱。佛教思想不單在大理盛行，亦是中原的重要精神支柱，從觀賞宏偉龍門石窟，可見佛教在北魏，以至唐代是十分受皇家推崇。今天，大理國已成歷史煙雲，但在大理古城西面的諾鄧古村，仍保留著古代鹽井、鹽馬古道，承傳著古老的製鹽方法，是現存少有的原貌古村落，村內處處滲透著古樸的大理遺風。. 小說《西遊記》形容火焰山年年噴火，是孫悟空踢翻八卦爐，餘火掉到地上，才形成火焰山。真實的火焰山是在新疆吐魯番地區，古稱西域。是什麼地理因素，使這裏有高溫而乾旱的天氣呢？幸好地下水沿豐富，適合葡萄生長。由公元前五至六年開始，在塔里木盆地相繼出現了30多個大大小小的陸洲國家，史稱「西域三十六國」。其中較有名的是大宛及烏孫。漢朝時曾派遣張騫出使西域，這個出使又是什麼原因呢？. 主持：文恩澄. 嘉賓:朱銘堅博士(香港大學中文學院助理教授).
